name: draw_items
role: draws every item: page frame, then for each item copies its words into P(), calls draw_item, flushes points

name: index_items
role: rebuilds ITEM_PTR0 and the item count from the length words

name: load_item_header
role: LOAD_I -> LOAD_W, LOAD_LEN, LOAD_CODE, LOAD_STAFF, LOAD_P3

name: draw_item
role: IP(k) = INT(P(k)); item_position; switch on code 1..18

name: item_position
role: X_POS = 150 * P3, Y_POS = STAFF_Y(staff) + P4 * 7 * STEP

name: draw_staff_number
role: screen-only staff number text left of the staff

name: staff_p4_error
role: draw_staff when P4 >= 1000: formats an error message, draws nothing

name: draw_page_frame
role: green page outline per PAPER, drawn as a code-12 box

name: fit_view
role: draws everything, takes the bounding box of the output, sets VIEW_DY = max y + 3000

name: emit_points
role: point buffer -> vector output (x + VIEW_DX, y - VIEW_DY, colour | pen << 24)

name: add_point
role: add_point(&x, &y, &pen): appends INT(x), INT(y), pen to the point buffer

name: amod
role: amod(&x, &y) = x - INT(x / y) * y (Fortran AMOD)

name: push_words
role: push_words(&n, a): saves n words on an internal stack

name: barline_stroke
role: vertical stroke at the bar x from y_bot to y_top

name: barline_dots
role: repeat dots (code-12 boxes) on every spanned staff

name: barline_brace
role: brace (type 8) via the clef routine, symbol 5

name: box_outline
role: closed rectangle polyline from the corner globals 0x1F93E60..0x1F93E7C (code-12 boxes, page frame)

name: note_ledger_lines
role: ledger lines of a note (draw_note, when P4 < 2 or > 12, or P30)

name: load_symbol_library
role: builds lbNNNN.drw and reads it; 'Not found' dialog if missing

name: input_rhythm_spacing
role: IN pass 2: rhythms and horizontal spacing (input.md)

name: input_min_gap
role: IN: minimum gap of 3 after pass 2 (input.md)

name: input_store_items
role: IN: writes the work table into the item store

name: input_pass
role: IN: parse one pass text and dispatch on the pass number

name: input_rhythm_value
role: IN: decode one rhythm value (dur, type, dots, tails)

name: input_pitches
role: IN pass 1: work table from pitches

name: input_range_dialog
role: IN range dialog: IP5 begin, IP6 end, IP7 spacing staff

name: cmd_I
role: commands starting with I: I n (edit item n), II, IN (staged input); also entered after item creation

name: edit_params
role: edit mode: parameter pairs p v, relative and transfer forms (commands.md)

name: edit_letters
role: edit mode: letter commands (/p relative, R/L/U/D moves, accidentals, ...)

name: create_by_mnemonic
role: creates an item from a three-letter mnemonic of the table at 0x7911EC (NOT, RES, CLE, ...)

name: lineup_answer
role: LJ/LI/J: takes the staff answer or box, confirms, runs

name: ask_source_box
role: asks 'Source Box O.K.?' through the yes/no callback 0x595CD0

name: drag_move
role: mouse drag (~v/~s/~t): new P3/P4 into the edit buffer (editing.md)

name: region_select
role: drag rectangle to an x range and staff range

name: text_record_header
role: text record header per font change (text.md)

name: text_rotate
role: rotates text positions by P9 (display.md, text.md)

name: anint
role: Fortran ANINT: x +/- 0.5 in f64, chopped (numerics.md)
